title: Fachinformation and patient information headings
text: The Fachinformation uses the headings of AMZV Annex 4 and the patient information those of Annex 5.1, in order and with the standard wording.
simplified: The app checks the German headings; French and Italian versions follow the same order.

title: Required content is filled
text: Each heading of the Fachinformation and patient information has content.

title: Black triangle (additional monitoring)
text: New active substances, biological medicines authorised since 2019, time-limited authorisations and authorisations with conditions carry the black triangle and the standard text at the top of the Fachinformation and the patient information, until the authorisation is renewed.

title: Reporting text in "Unerwünschte Wirkungen"
text: The section on undesirable effects ends with the request to report suspected new or serious adverse reactions through the ElViS portal.
simplified: The app looks for the reporting paragraph and the name ElViS (or ElViS 2.0).

title: Authorisation number
text: The authorisation number is the five-digit Swissmedic number followed by "(Swissmedic)", the same in the Fachinformation and the patient information.

title: Dispensing category
text: The packs section gives the dispensing category (Abgabekategorie A to E).

title: Date of the information
text: The Fachinformation ends with the month and year of the information ("Stand der Information"); the patient information ends with the month it was last checked by Swissmedic.
